mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed log collection outage, collector delay, device silence, or telemetry EPS drop matching the rule condition (represents an operational health True Positive, not a cyberattack).
mappings.fp_semantics: Telemetry confirms logs/heartbeats resumed normally, planned maintenance window explains silence, or rule triggered on transient noise/decommissioned host.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Reporting device/collector state or outage telemetry is missing or contradictory.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed configuration modification on firewall/network/security appliance that is verified unauthorized or unapproved (lacks verified change ticket/approved config context).
mappings.fp_semantics: Configuration change is corroborated by an approved change ticket, maintenance window, or verified authorized administrative baseline.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Change event lacks target object/user context or authorization state cannot be verified.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed horizontal host sweep or multi-port TCP scan from an unapproved/untrusted source targeting internal or monitored assets without verified scanner authorization.
mappings.fp_semantics: Source IP is verified in organizational context as an authorized vulnerability scanner, IT discovery/monitoring system, or approved penetration test within valid change/maintenance scope.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Scan target/source telemetry is missing or scanner authorization cannot be established.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed sustained unauthorized probing, excessive perimeter denies from untrusted/external sources, or active policy-violating traffic matching rule criteria. Firewall deny/block does NOT automatically make a scan/probe FP.
mappings.fp_semantics: Traffic originates from verified authorized infrastructure, approved external service, or benign enterprise web/application traffic with verified organizational/policy context.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Source/destination, firewall action, or authorization context is insufficient.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed exploit payload, SQLi/XSS/RCE signature match, or intrusion attempt targeting exposed services (even if blocked/dropped by IPS when rule detects attempted attack).
mappings.fp_semantics: Verified signature false alarm on benign application input, authorized security assessment/pen-test, or approved test traffic with verified context.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Payload/URL/signature detail is absent or target/authorization context cannot be verified.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed communication with a threat-intelligence IOC (malicious IP/domain/hash), especially permitted or bidirectional traffic without verified sinkhole/authorized security tool context.
mappings.fp_semantics: Traffic is verified benign (e.g., authorized threat-intel lookup, sinkhole, or verified stale/reclaimed IP with clean organizational destination context).
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Matched IOC, traffic direction, or firewall action is missing or ambiguous.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed anomalous/excessive DNS queries, DGA/tunneling indicators, or unauthorized DNS resolver usage from non-resolver hosts without verified infrastructure authorization.
mappings.fp_semantics: Source is a verified corporate DNS forwarder/resolver, authorized AD domain controller, or approved monitoring/CDN resolver in organizational context.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Query details, source host role, or DNS destination context is missing.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed large or anomalous outbound transfer to an unapproved external destination, personal cloud, or foreign endpoint without verified business authorization.
mappings.fp_semantics: Transfer matches verified authorized backup, corporate cloud destination, CDN, or approved data transfer in organizational context.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Transfer direction, byte volume, or destination authorization cannot be established.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed credential stuffing, brute force, account lockout storm, cleartext credential exposure, or anomalous impossible-travel/foreign logon without verified user travel/VPN authorization.
mappings.fp_semantics: Verified authorized user/VPN travel, expired service account under documented rotation, or approved security testing with verified identity/change context.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: User identity, source IP, or authentication outcome is missing.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed malicious process execution, unauthorized remote admin tool, credential access, tampering, or known malware file hash without verified authorization.
mappings.fp_semantics: Verified approved administrative software from trusted path/signature, or authorized IT maintenance backed by verified change/tool context.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Process/file/command-line or authorization evidence is insufficient.

mappings.tp_semantics: Confirmed rule condition match with verified malicious or unauthorized activity.
mappings.fp_semantics: Verified authorized benign activity or confirmed detection error.
mappings.inconclusive_semantics: Rule semantics or telemetry are insufficient for safe classification.
